options.text: Deploys the MCP host, not SQL grants. A DBA must run the generated setup script. Private SQL requires an approved Container Apps network path. No database or firewall is opened automatically.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 2-20 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens; start with a letter and end with a letter or digit.

elements.name: server
elements.label: SQL TLS hostname
elements.toolTip: For Azure SQL, use server.database.windows.net. For a VM, use the DNS name on its SQL TLS certificate.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a SQL hostname, not a URL, IP override or connection string.
Enter a TCP port from 1 to 65535.

elements.name: authentication
elements.label: MCP host to SQL authentication
elements.defaultValue: Managed identity (Azure SQL; configured SQL 2022+ VM)

allowedValues.label: Managed identity (Azure SQL; configured SQL 2022+ VM)

constraints.validationMessage: Use only a pre-provisioned dedicated reader, never an administrator.

elements.name: environment
elements.label: Existing Container Apps environment resource ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Use an environment in the deployment region with SQL DNS/routing. Leave empty to create an environment.

elements.name: subnet
elements.label: New environment's approved subnet resource ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Dedicated subnet delegated to Microsoft.App/environments. Required for private SQL unless you selected an existing connected environment. No existing subnets or DNS links are modified.

label.password: MCP API key (save in your password manager)

constraints.validationMessage: Use 32-128 random letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
